method: Original pixels inspected before source. Scores are subjective visual judgments for the compact game asset, not measured likeness.

boundedCorrection.observation: Four square timber ends protrude through the blue roof near both eaves. These persist in top, opposite sides, rear obliques and clay, so are real attachments rather than shading.
boundedCorrection.hypothesis: Shorten or fit the underlying timber ends below the continuous roof underside while preserving shell, roof, canopy and pier silhouettes.
boundedCorrection.requiredDelta: Roof attachment score at least 0.89 (+0.10), every required score at least 0.85, no critical regression over 0.05.
boundedCorrection.controls: Same 11 cameras, same macro proportions, no finish additions until gate passes.

views.market-world-azimuth-0: Partial market evidence; lighthouse quay overlaps frontage.
views.market-world-azimuth-90: Market fully occluded by lighthouse; not clearance proof.
views.market-world-azimuth-180: Quay/building collision and boats within pier supports are visible.
views.market-world-azimuth-270: Lighthouse stone quay cuts through market counter and door zone; boat overlaps pier bracing.

assembly.correctionScope: Move market outboard within dock parent, add supported access spur and clear decorative boat/pier intersections. Preserve frozen lighthouse and neighboring architecture. Recapture actual four-angle assembly before approval.

remainingTargetGap: Finish deliberately absent. Target weathering, planking, market stock and hardware are not evaluated at macro stage.
